study: Protected photo-direction intervention on actual generated images
subject: sub-04

conditions: Use the registered native learned word and unit H/14 direction; protect the global training mean, 96 object-centroid PCA axes and row-specific eight-support mean. gate: Advance to the other three menus only if both paired all-120 DINO ten-photo accuracy lower 95% bounds are strictly positive for own minus native and own minus wrong, and all-120 full1854 true-object naming credit is at least native. No tuning on these images.
